verdict_basis: CAMPAIGN_RESULT.json: experiments_preregistered 8, experiments_run 8, lockboxes_computed 1, skeptic_survivors 0, validated_survivors 0, director_cleared 0, forward_requests_created 0. Zero survivors is arithmetic, not judgement. Nothing was cleared, nothing published, no forward request created, no operational surface touched.

rulings.question: 1. BASIS MOMENTUM - is the mechanism dead in this estate, or was the test underpowered?
rulings.ruling: UNDERPOWERED, AND THEREFORE NOT REOPENABLE AS SPECIFIED. The estate did not measure the absence of basis momentum; it measured nothing at all, twice, and must not be allowed to record that as knowledge.
rulings.reasoning: Every number this mechanism produced sits inside the noise band. r60_01: D +1.09%/yr t 0.596, V -0.82%/yr t -0.283. r60_06 (disjoint-instrument replication): D -0.89%/yr t -0.682 (CAMPAIGN_RESULT.json cells r60_01, r60_06). Three reads, |t| < 0.69 on all three. A test whose largest absolute t-statistic across three independent reads is 0.68 cannot distinguish a zero premium from the 5-10%/yr the literature documents for this mechanism on broad commodity panels; the standard error swamps both hypotheses. The sign disagreement between D and V is therefore not evidence of a fragile premium - it is the expected behaviour of two draws from the same near-zero-information distribution, and I decline to read it as a finding in either direction. The structural cause is the panel, not the signal: a commodity futures cross-section with an instrument count in the low tens and roughly fifteen years of history yields very few effectively independent cross-sectional bets at a 21-session horizon, and the cross-asset replication widened the instruments without deepening the history. The deferred-leg rescue from the certified layer was real engineering value and the pre-test against settled carry (median Spearman 0.22, 0 of 185 decisions at the kill threshold) correctly established non-duplication - both stand. What neither established is that the resulting test could have detected the effect if it were there. I record this as the campaign's most important negative: the strongest documented commodity predictor the estate had never tested was tested, and the estate still does not know the answer. I explicitly refuse the softer reading that it is 'weak but real' and the harder reading that it is 'dead'. Both overclaim.
rulings.what_would_change_it: A pre-registered power calibration on the exact commodity and cross-asset panels used here, run BEFORE any retest: inject a synthetic signal of known ex-ante magnitude into the real panels under the real frozen cost models and the real layered D/V/L gate, sweep the effect size, and report the detection-probability curve. If the minimum detectable effect at 80% power exceeds the published effect size, basis momentum is NOT_TESTABLE_IN_THIS_ESTATE and must be marked so rather than left in the graveyard as a failure - the graveyard entry is currently mislabelled evidence. If the MDE is comfortably below the published effect size, then this estate CAN see it and did not, and the mechanism may be ruled dead here on the existing reads with no further spend. Only after that calibration, and only with a materially deeper panel (longer history or a genuinely larger instrument count, not a re-parameterisation), would a new pre-registered experiment be justified. A re-run at a different horizon, lookback or weighting on the SAME panel is prohibited: it is the no-rescue rule, it would be charged to burden, and it would be equally unable to answer the question.

rulings.question: 2. THE TURNOVER CEILING - right constraint, or an estate that cannot express fast signals at all?
rulings.ruling: THE CEILING IS MISSPECIFIED AS A SCALAR. A single 0.40 one-way monthly number applied across asset classes and horizons is horizon-blind and cost-blind, and it killed two futures cells for a cost that futures do not pay. The underlying constraint is correct in intent and wrong in units: it must be a net-cost budget derived from each cell's own frozen cost model and rebalance frequency, not a raw turnover scalar. This is my own pre-registration defect and I own it.
rulings.reasoning: The three halts are not one phenomenon, they are two. (a) r60_08, EQ_EXTENSION_H5_IMMEDIACY_REVERSAL, measured 0.870 one-way at a 5-session horizon on a 25 bp/side equity cost model. Near-complete book replacement is intrinsic to a 5-day reversal, not a defect in its implementation, and at 25 bp/side it implies a cost drag on the order of twenty percent a year. Here the ceiling was miscalibrated in form but CORRECT in outcome: no realistic cross-sectional reversal premium survives that drag. My Phase-1 note that for H1-H5 'turnover, not signal, is the binding constraint' is confirmed, and the correct conclusion is that at this estate's assumed equity cost level fast reversal is not expressible - a real and binding limit, not a bug. (b) r60_05 (0.598) and r60_07 (0.612) were monthly open-interest-growth signals on COMMODITY_FUTURES and EQUITY_INDEX_FUTURES. Futures transact at a small fraction of 25 bp/side; a monthly one-way turnover of 0.60 on a liquid futures book is a materially smaller annual drag than the equity case and is nowhere near economically fatal. Those two cells were killed by a number imported from an equity cost world, before any return was scored. That is not a research finding. That is a constraint I froze without matching it to the instrument, and it destroyed two of the campaign's four non-equity cells.
rulings.what_would_change_it: Two separable owners, and they must not be conflated. (i) The CONSTRAINT SCHEMA is mine. Before any further cell is pre-registered, the turnover gate must be re-expressed as a pre-registered net-cost budget - projected annual cost drag = one-way turnover x cost per side x 2 x rebalances per year, evaluated against the cell's frozen cost model - with a single campaign-wide drag ceiling replacing the per-cell turnover scalar. The schema must be changed campaign-wide and pinned by a test BEFORE any cell is registered under it, so that no ceiling is ever chosen after a turnover is observed. (ii) The REALISM OF THE COST MODEL ITSELF - whether 25 bp/side is the right all-in assumption for a mid/small-cap equity book - is an execution-model question and belongs to whoever owns the cost and execution model, not to a signal agent and not to me. If that assumption is materially conservative, an entire horizon band is currently invisible to this estate for reasons that have nothing to do with alpha, and that is worth knowing before any further fast-horizon hypothesis is registered. GOVERNANCE: r60_05, r60_07 and r60_08 may NOT be re-run under a changed ceiling. Each would be a NEW pre-registered experiment with a new experiment id, charged to the burden. Their halts stand as recorded.

rulings.question: 3. THE NEW EXTENSION SUBSTRATE - worth building, and what next?
rulings.ruling: WORTH BUILDING, NOT YET WORTH BELIEVING. Retain it; freeze it against further candidate scoring until the identity bridge is audited. Do not set it aside, and do not read three failed cells as evidence against it.
rulings.reasoning: The substrate was not falsified by this campaign because it was barely exercised, and none of the three deaths on it is attributable to the substrate. r60_02 died on statistics at a burden denominator of 1 - it failed before any multiple-testing discount was applied (skeptic_review.json gate_authority: lockbox_t 0.756, lockbox_p_one_sided 0.2248, burden_denominator 1). r60_03 died at discovery with the wrong sign (-1.23%/yr, t -0.608). r60_08 never produced a return at all, halting on the turnover ceiling I have just ruled misspecified. Zero of three deaths carries information about the panel. What the substrate is worth, structurally, is real: it is the first substrate below the S&P 500 in 1,858 equity tests, 2,947 names with a median 1,000 tradable per decision and delisted names retained. Most of the documented cross-sectional equity effects the estate has settled on large caps are published as monotone-increasing as capitalisation falls, so a large-cap null is weak evidence about the tail. But the substrate's value is currently UNBOUNDED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, because its identity layer is unaudited: a positive result found on it today could not be believed, and that asymmetry - where success is uninterpretable and failure is uninformative - means further alpha spend on it right now has close to zero expected information value.
rulings.what_would_change_it: Sequence, not volume. (1) Audit the identity bridge to the specification below. (2) Then run a KNOWN-ANSWER CALIBRATION, not a candidate: score the estate's already-settled S&P 500 factors on the extension universe as controls. A factor with a known large-cap behaviour should reproduce a recognisable behaviour on the tail; if instead it produces extreme ranks populated by low-confidence-bridge names, the substrate is contaminating and the audit missed it. This is substrate validation, asserts no alpha claim, and must be recorded so that it does not consume alpha burden. (3) Only then ask the substrate the questions only it can answer: mechanisms whose published effect strengthens as capitalisation falls, and which are NOT re-expressions of large-cap price formulas the estate has already settled. If the audit cannot bound the bridge error rate, set the substrate aside - an unauditable panel is worse than no panel, because it manufactures confident-looking extremes.

rulings.question: 4. THE SKEPTIC'S CAMPAIGN-LEVEL BLOCKERS - must the identity bridge be audited before the substrate is used again?
rulings.ruling: YES. BLOCKING. No further candidate may be scored on the extension substrate until the issuer-name identity bridge is audited to a pre-registered, falsifiable specification. I adopt the skeptic's recommendation in full on this point.
rulings.reasoning: The skeptic recorded attack 3 as INCONCLUSIVE rather than passed, and the mechanism of harm it names is specific, plausible and unmeasured: identity is resolved by ISSUER NAME against former-name records, 90.8% of delisted and 99.9% of live, leaving a 9.2% unbridged delisted tail that is concentrated in the corporate-action-heavy names a share-count ratio is most sensitive to (skeptic_review.json attacks[2]). The harm is not additive noise. A wrong name match splices one firm's share count onto another's across a one-year ratio and produces an enormous spurious log ratio, which lands the name at an EXTREME of the ranking - so a book that takes the bottom 100 of about 1,000 is a selection mechanism biased TOWARD mis-bridged names. Attack 5 compounds it: a sampled issuer carried -25,878,050 shares later corrected to +25,878,050, which is a sign error, not a missing value, and the errors that survive a non-positive filter are the positive ones - a units error of 1000x stays positive, passes the filter, and lands in the same tail. The rank-book construction concentrates data corruption by design. On the reporting defects: I am told two of three are repaired, including the understated search burden now pinned by a test - accepted, and note the direction was always safe, since a larger denominator only moves a candidate further from significance (skeptic_review.json multiple_testing_exposure). The remaining MAX_DRAWDOWN_SURFACE_DISAGREEMENT - 0.0000 on all three layers on the director surface against non-zero strat_max_dd -0.1791/-0.3973/-0.2042 in the brief - is NOT blocking at the discovery or lockbox stage, because no gate reads a drawdown field and no ruling in this campaign turned on one. It becomes BLOCKING the moment a candidate reaches the risk agent, which does rule on drawdown, and the risk agent was never reached this campaign. It must be reconciled before the next candidate is handed to risk. I decline to inflate it into a discovery-stage blocker; a proportionate blocker is one that stops the stage it can actually corrupt.
rulings.what_would_change_it: The audit passing against thresholds registered BEFORE it is run. If the bridge cannot be bounded against an independent permanent identifier, the finding is that the substrate's identity layer is unauditable with the data on hand, and the substrate is set aside rather than used - not softened into a caveat attached to future results.

rulings.question: 5. THE TOURNAMENT
rulings.ruling: NO TOURNAMENT IS HELD. There is nothing to rank.
rulings.reasoning: Zero validated survivors, zero director clearances, zero forward requests (CAMPAIGN_RESULT.json). A tournament ranks candidates against incumbents; with an empty candidate set the ranking is undefined, and any statement about how R60 'compares' to the operational US-equity sleeve, the existing forward challengers, FX carry, managed futures or S25 would be manufactured. The honest statement is the short one: R60 contributes no candidate to any incumbent comparison, changes no allocation, changes no ranking and touches no operational surface. The one real estate-level consequence is in the opposite direction from a win - the campaign's 20 charged cells now sit in the search-burden denominator of every future claim in these families, so R60 has made the next candidate in this space HARDER to qualify, which is the correct and intended price of having looked.
rulings.what_would_change_it: A future campaign producing at least one candidate that is skeptic SURVIVED, risk ACCEPTABLE and meta ENSEMBLE_READY or STANDALONE. Until then there is no comparison to run and none will be reported.

rulings.question: 6. NEXT HIGHEST VALUE ACTION
rulings.ruling: MEASURE THE ESTATE'S OWN DETECTION FLOOR BEFORE REGISTERING ANOTHER HYPOTHESIS. See NEXT_HIGHEST_VALUE_ACTION.
rulings.reasoning: 8,445 + 8 settled hypotheses and zero qualified survivors admits exactly two explanations: the reachable opportunity set is genuinely empty at this estate's data and cost level, or the testing apparatus lacks the power to detect alpha that is present. After more than eight thousand tests with not one positive, an apparatus that has never once produced a survivor is observationally indistinguishable from one with no power, and the estate has never measured which it is. Every further hypothesis registered before that question is answered is spent at an unknown and possibly zero detection probability. This campaign gave the sharpest instance: the strongest documented commodity predictor the estate had never tried returned |t| < 0.69 on all three reads - a result that is uninterpretable without knowing the panel's minimum detectable effect.
rulings.what_would_change_it: The calibration itself. It is designed to be decisive in either direction, which is precisely why it outranks any further search.

basis_momentum_verdict_detail: Not DEAD_IN_THIS_ESTATE: nothing was ruled out, because |t| < 0.69 on all three reads (D +1.09%/yr t 0.596, V -0.82%/yr t -0.283, disjoint replication D -0.89%/yr t -0.682) cannot separate zero from the published effect size. Not UNRESOLVED in the sense of pending a retest: it must NOT be retested on the same panel under any re-parameterisation. It is blocked behind a power calibration, and its graveyard entry must be annotated so a later campaign does not read it as evidence of absence.
turnover_ceiling_verdict: MISSPECIFIED_AS_A_SCALAR_AND_MUST_BECOME_A_NET_COST_BUDGET. For equities at the estate's 25 bp/side cost model the constraint is real and binding - r60_08's 0.870 one-way at a 5-session horizon is economically fatal and fast equity reversal is genuinely not expressible here, which is an EXECUTION-MODEL limitation owned by the cost/execution-model owner, not a research finding. For futures the same scalar was imported from an equity cost world and killed r60_05 (0.598) and r60_07 (0.612) before any return was scored, for a cost futures do not pay; that is a PRE-REGISTRATION DEFECT owned by me. The schema must be changed campaign-wide and pinned by a test before any cell is registered under it, never per cell after a turnover is observed. The three halts stand; replacements are new experiment ids charged to burden.
substrate_verdict: RETAIN_BUT_FREEZE_PENDING_AUDIT. Worth building - first substrate below the S&P 500 in 1,858 equity tests, 2,947 names, median 1,000 tradable per decision, delisted retained - and not falsified by this campaign, since none of the three deaths on it is attributable to the panel. But with an unaudited identity layer, success on it is uninterpretable and failure on it is uninformative, so further alpha spend on it now has near-zero expected information value. No further candidate is scored on it until the bridge audit passes.
identity_bridge_audit_must_establish: A measured FALSE-MATCH RATE for the issuer-name bridge against an independent permanent identifier (CUSIP / PERMNO / FIGI or the vendor's own persistent entity id), reported as a rate over a random audited sample with a confidence interval - not as an anecdote and not as a spot check of names that already looked wrong.

That the 9.2% unbridged delisted tail is CONDITIONALLY IGNORABLE: attrition broken out by termination reason (merger, acquisition, buyout, bankruptcy, exchange move, voluntary deregistration) and shown to be uncorrelated with both the features scored and with forward returns. The skeptic's specific hazard must be tested head-on - that the missing tail is disproportionately stock-financed M&A at firms that had been repurchasing, i.e. correlated with the feature AND the outcome simultaneously.

The RANK-CONTAMINATION CHANNEL, quantified: for every ratio-form feature, the share of the extreme deciles occupied by names whose bridge confidence is below threshold. A rank book concentrates identity errors by construction; the audit must bound that concentration, not merely bound the average error rate.

That CORPORATE ACTIONS which change share count without economic issuance - splits, reverse splits, stock-financed M&A, spin-offs, rights issues - are identified and adjusted point-in-time, and are separable from genuine issuance and repurchase. The raw ratio cannot tell them apart and the estate currently has no evidence that anything does.

That the DATA-QUALITY floor is a bound and not just a filter: the extraction pipeline that emitted a -25,878,050 share count later corrected to +25,878,050 must be characterised for sign, units and entity-attribution errors that remain POSITIVE and therefore survive the non-positive filter untouched.

That SURVIVORSHIP IS ACTUALLY CURED, not merely addressed: every delisted name must carry a terminal delisting return rather than simply ceasing to appear. A retained-but-truncated delisted name is survivorship bias with extra steps.

REPRODUCIBILITY: the bridge must be a versioned, content-hashed artifact, so that a later campaign scores against the same identity map that was audited and any change to the map invalidates prior scores on it rather than silently re-basing them.
PRE-REGISTERED PASS/FAIL THRESHOLDS, frozen before the audit is run, with the substrate set aside on failure. An audit graded after the fact is not an audit.

tournament.comparison: None is possible and none is offered. With zero validated survivors there is no candidate to rank against the operational US-equity sleeve, the existing forward challengers, FX carry, managed futures or S25. R60 changes no allocation, no ranking, no champion and no forward clock, and created no forward request. Its only estate-level effect is on the burden: the campaign's 20 charged cells now sit in the search-burden denominator of every future claim in these families, which makes the next candidate here harder to qualify - the correct price of having looked.

what_we_learned: The estate can now reach the futures deferred-leg basis. The rescue of a layer two agents had reported unusable was genuine capability gain and it survives this campaign's negative result; the capability is retained even though the hypothesis is not.

Basis momentum is not a duplicate of settled carry here - pre-tested at median Spearman 0.22 with 0 of 185 decisions at the kill threshold - so the estate's non-duplication machinery worked as designed on a hard case. The information that it added, however, was indistinguishable from noise on the available panel.

A pre-registered halt gate fires. Four of eight cells stopped before any return was scored - one on a dividend-declaration coverage floor (2011 0.717, 2012 0.782 against 0.80), three on the turnover ceiling - and none was re-smoothed, re-banded or re-tranched into compliance (CAMPAIGN_RESULT.json halt_detail). The anti-rescue discipline held under pressure, which is the single most valuable thing this campaign demonstrated.

A pre-registered constraint can be WRONG as well as binding. The same mechanism that correctly killed r60_08 incorrectly killed r60_05 and r60_07 by pricing futures at equity costs, and no amount of discipline in enforcing a constraint repairs a constraint specified in the wrong units.

The single lockbox this campaign earned failed at a burden denominator of 1 - p 0.2248 against a frozen q of 0.10, with no multiple-testing discount applied at all (skeptic_review.json gate_authority). Multiple testing was not what killed R60; the absence of signal was.

Reaching a lockbox is not evidence. r60_02's +2.17%/yr cleared a materiality floor while its lockbox halves ran +5.42%/yr then -1.09%/yr - a size claim on a number whose sign was never established. The materiality floor is a companion to significance, never a substitute for it.

Routing by elimination corrupts the duplication check. CORPORATE_FINANCING is not a routed family, so net share issuance was scored inside the settled VALUATION family, and the estate consequently has no evidence about where that information sits relative to its settled factor because it was never placed on economic grounds (skeptic_review.json attacks[5]).

Disjoint holdings do not imply disjoint exposure. Two books can share approximately zero names and nearly all factor exposure; the extension universe bounds name overlap at about zero and bounds factor overlap at nothing.
The estate has never measured its own detection floor. That gap, not any individual hypothesis, is what made this campaign's central negative uninterpretable.
where_the_next_edge_may_be: In the apparatus, not the hypothesis space: a measured detection-probability curve would convert 8,453 uninterpretable nulls into either a genuine statement about the market or a repairable engineering defect. This is currently the highest-information unknown in the estate.

In mechanisms that are structurally slow - event-conditioned, capacity-heavy, low-turnover - which the estate's cost model can actually express. The fast-horizon band is closed at 25 bp/side and no amount of signal work reopens it.

In the mid/small-cap tail, CONDITIONAL on the bridge audit passing, and restricted to mechanisms whose published effect strengthens as capitalisation falls rather than large-cap price formulas re-run on a new population.

In EQ_DIVIDEND_DECLARATION_DRIFT (r60_04) re-registered with its sample start frozen at the first year declarationDate coverage clears 0.80 - permissible only as a NEW pre-registration whose start year is fixed from the coverage series BEFORE any return is computed, and charged to burden. No return was ever scored, so there is no outcome to fit to; that is what makes it legitimate and it must stay that way.

In cross-sectional panels with enough instruments to be powered. The commodity and cross-asset panels have too few instruments to resolve the effect sizes the estate is hunting; a mechanism testable on a wide single-name cross-section is worth more per unit of burden than the same mechanism on twenty futures.

In genuinely new information rather than new formulas over old information - but that is an acquisition and cost decision for a human, not a research recommendation I am authorised to make, and I make none here.

NEXT_HIGHEST_VALUE_ACTION.action: POWER CALIBRATION OF THE RESEARCH APPARATUS, before another hypothesis is pre-registered. Using alpha_agent.agents_v2.runner on the frozen panels this estate already has - US equity, the extension universe, commodity futures, equity index futures, cross-asset - inject a SYNTHETIC signal of known ex-ante information coefficient into the real returns, under the real frozen cost models, the real turnover constraint, the real layered D/V/L gate and the real burden denominator. Sweep the injected effect size across a range spanning zero to well above published effect magnitudes, with enough seeds per point to estimate the detection probability, and publish one minimum-detectable-effect curve per panel at the estate's frozen q of 0.10. Deliverable: a per-panel MDE at 80% power. It asserts no hypothesis, makes no alpha claim, and must be recorded so that it consumes no alpha search burden.
NEXT_HIGHEST_VALUE_ACTION.why: The estate has settled 8,453 hypotheses with zero qualified survivors and has never once checked that its pipeline can detect alpha that is present. Until that is known, every NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE verdict is ambiguous between 'there is nothing there' and 'we could not have seen it', and every further hypothesis is spent at an unknown detection probability - possibly zero on the thinner panels. This one measurement retroactively reprices the entire back catalogue: it tells the estate which of its eight thousand nulls are evidence and which are silence. It also settles ruling 1 as a by-product, at no extra cost, since basis momentum's fate turns entirely on the commodity panel's MDE. It proposes no new price formulas, no new dataset, no purchase and no DATA_HOLD reversal.
NEXT_HIGHEST_VALUE_ACTION.effort: Low and bounded. One campaign slot. No new data, no new vendor, no backfill, zero incremental data cost. Reuses the existing local deterministic runner and the existing frozen panels and cost models end to end; the new code is a synthetic-signal injector and a sweep harness. Estimate on the order of one engineering day plus compute for the sweep, and zero alpha burden charged because no hypothesis is registered. The most expensive thing about it is the discipline to run it BEFORE the next campaign instead of after.
NEXT_HIGHEST_VALUE_ACTION.what_would_falsify_it: If the calibration shows the pipeline detects a modest net premium - say 3%/yr net of the frozen costs - at 80% power or better on every panel the estate has tested, then the apparatus is sound, the 8,453 nulls are real information about the market rather than artifacts of low power, and my premise is wrong. That outcome is equally valuable and is the point: it would mean the estate should stop searching formula space over price and filed fundamentals altogether and either pursue genuinely new information or accept the frontier where it is. The recommendation is falsifiable, cheap, and decisive in both directions - which is exactly what distinguishes it from another campaign of hypotheses.

do_not_repeat: Basis momentum on the current commodity or cross-asset instrument sets at any horizon, lookback or weighting. Both legs are read; only a power change, not a parameter change, can justify a new experiment, and the graveyard entry must be annotated UNDERPOWERED rather than left to be read as evidence of absence.

EQ_EXTENSION_NET_SHARE_ISSUANCE in any form. Killed at a burden denominator of 1; the reopen condition is the skeptic's five-part list in what_would_change_my_mind, all of which must hold simultaneously, and a resubmission under a different label is prohibited.
EQ_EXTENSION_GROSS_PROFITABILITY on the extension universe at 21 sessions. Halted at discovery with the wrong sign.

Re-registering r60_05, r60_07 or r60_08 under a hand-adjusted turnover ceiling. The constraint schema is corrected campaign-wide and pinned by a test FIRST; only then may a new experiment id be minted and charged. A ceiling chosen after a turnover is observed is outcome-directed tuning regardless of how it is documented.
Scoring ANY further candidate on the extension substrate before the identity-bridge audit passes its pre-registered thresholds.
Handing any candidate to the risk agent before the MAX_DRAWDOWN_SURFACE_DISAGREEMENT is reconciled. The risk agent rules on drawdown and the two surfaces currently disagree.

Routing a hypothesis into a settled economic family by elimination. If no family fits on economics, that is a scope question for a human, not a label to be assigned for convenience - and it silently voids the duplication check.

Another sweep of price-formula variants inside families this estate has already settled, on any population. A new population is not a reopen condition on its own; that rule is not suspended because a new substrate exists.
Treating a lockbox that was merely REACHED as a partial success. One lockbox was computed this campaign and it failed with no multiple-testing discount applied against it.

budget_state.note: The lockbox budget was spent once and returned p 0.2248. Seven of eight cells halted before the lockbox, which is the budget behaving correctly. No budget is carried forward as an entitlement; the next campaign's ceiling is set on its own evidence.

blocking_for_next_campaign: Identity-bridge audit of the extension universe, to the specification in identity_bridge_audit_must_establish.
Turnover constraint re-specified as a per-cell net-cost budget, campaign-wide, pinned by a test, before any cell is registered under it.
MAX_DRAWDOWN_SURFACE_DISAGREEMENT reconciled before any candidate reaches the risk agent.
human_decisions_required: Whether 25 bp/side is the correct all-in cost assumption for a mid/small-cap equity book. This determines whether an entire horizon band is permanently invisible to this estate, and it is an execution-model decision, not a research one.
Any acquisition of genuinely new information. I recommend none and am not authorised to.

safety.note: No director_clear call was made or could be made: there are zero validated survivors, and the CLEARED precondition (skeptic SURVIVED + risk ACCEPTABLE + meta ENSEMBLE_READY/STANDALONE) is unsatisfiable on an empty candidate set.
